title: Alert: Learning Trigger Functions for Early Classification of Time Series using Deep-RL
abstract: arXiv:2502.06584v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Early Classification of Time Series (ECTS) is vital in fields like industrial monitoring and medical triage, where quick and accurate predictions are essential. One of the core challenges lies in the trigger function, which decides when to make a prediction, independently of the classifier itself. Most existing methods rely on handcrafted rules, but can data-driven approaches outperform them? This paper introduces Alert, a Deep-RL framework that learns trigger functions from any state representation. Systematic comparisons on 30 datasets show that the design of the state space significantly influences performance. Building on this, we propose Alert+, a simple yet effective variant that consistently outperforms traditional methods in balancing accuracy and delay within an imbalanced misclassification and exponential delay cost setting. Alert and Alert+ are released to support reproducible research and practical applications.

translated_title: Alert：使用深度强化学习为时间序列早期分类学习触发函数
translated_abstract: 时间序列早期分类（ECTS）在工业监控和医疗分诊等需要快速准确预测的领域中至关重要。其中一个核心挑战在于触发函数，它决定何时进行预测，且独立于分类器本身。现有方法大多依赖手工设计的规则，但数据驱动的方法能否超越它们？本文提出了Alert，一个能够从任意状态表示中学习触发函数的深度强化学习框架。在30个数据集上的系统性比较表明，状态空间的设计对性能有显著影响。基于此，我们提出了Alert+，一个简单而有效的变体，在不平衡误分类和指数延迟代价设置下，在平衡准确率与延迟方面持续优于传统方法。Alert和Alert+已被开源发布，以支持可复现研究和实际应用。
tldr: 本文提出基于深度强化学习的Alert框架，通过学习触发函数实现时间序列早期分类，其Alert+变体在不平衡误分类和指数延迟代价设置下，在准确率与延迟的平衡上持续优于传统方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Alert, a Deep-RL framework that learns trigger functions for early time series classification, with its Alert+ variant consistently outperforming traditional methods in balancing accuracy and delay under an imbalanced misclassification and exponential delay cost setting.
